# Security Policy

## Supported versions

The plugin is in early development. Security fixes are applied to the latest released version.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not open a public issue for security problems.**

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Loubal70/billing-abby-for-woocommerce/security/advisories/new)
(Security tab → "Report a vulnerability"), or by email to security@rankea.agency.

Please include:

- a description of the issue and its impact,
- steps to reproduce or a proof of concept,
- affected plugin / WordPress / WooCommerce / PHP versions.

We will acknowledge your report, keep you informed of the fix, and credit you if you wish.

## Scope

This plugin stores an Abby API key and sends order data to the Abby API. Reports about API key
exposure, data leakage to third parties, missing capability/nonce checks, or unescaped output
are especially welcome.
